Experimental_Design.Conditions: self-matching, self-mismatching, friend-matching, friend-mismatching, stranger-matching, stranger-mismatching (switch assignment: self->friend, friend->stranger, stranger->self)

Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 9 practice trials (paper; no practice rows present in the data export)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 648 formal trials per participant (8 blocks x 81 = 9 conditions x 72); 648 rows per participant in data

exp2.detail: Rebuilt in 2026-08 stage 4 from the author's E-Merge aggregate CSV exports in the study *_Raw/ input zone (the previous in-repo Exp1 five-file set was found to be erroneous AssoMatc_Self task data, archived in *_Raw/AssoMatc_Self_archive/). Data contain 25 participants (IDs 1-25) x 648 switch trials each; the paper reports N=20 analyzed (12 male; data: 10 male/15 female, mean age 23.52, 18-30) without a published exclusion list - data-caliber N=25 kept, paper caliber in CSV Note. Two phases: Association (Part 1 learning, variable rows per participant, author export lacks the displayed-label column so Clean Label/Matching are NA) and Breaking (Part 2 switch matching, full Label/Identity/Shape columns). Matching = displayed label conforms to the new assignment: self->friend, friend->stranger, stranger->self (Identity column = the shape's Part 1 identity, fixed per participant; validated against paper RT direction: self match RT fastest). Exp1 labels in raw are capitalized (Self/Friend/Stranger), Exp2 lowercase (self/friend/stranger), kept verbatim in Label/Origin columns. ACC 1/0 with no-response -> NA. Paper statistics approximately reproduced (match RT F=12.7 vs 17.4 paper, same direction); exact reproduction not achieved - see 3_Reports/Verifying_original_results_issues.md (Issue 3).
